prompt.text:
Implement a new in-memory chunk scheduling API by exporting `ChunkTransferQueue` and its supporting interfaces.

The constructor accepts an ordered array of `{ id, size }`, a positive integer `chunkSize`, and a positive integer `maxConcurrent`. Reject duplicate or empty IDs, negative or non-integer sizes, and invalid numeric settings with `RangeError`. Inputs must not be mutated or retained by reference.

`nextBatch()` returns at most `maxConcurrent` new `ChunkJob` objects, accounting for jobs already in flight. Schedule files in insertion order and allow at most one in-flight chunk per file. Each job contains `fileId`, `offset`, and the exact `length`; the last chunk may be shorter. Zero-byte files start completed.

Export methods `completeChunk(fileId, length)`, `failChunk(fileId)`, `retry(fileId)`, `pause(fileId)`, `resume(fileId)`, `cancel(fileId)`, `remove(fileId)`, and `snapshot()`. Completion must match the active chunk length or throw. Failure makes a file retryable without advancing it. Pausing an in-flight file takes effect after that chunk completes; otherwise it takes effect immediately. Cancellation is terminal unless removed. Removal works in any state. Unknown IDs and invalid state transitions throw `Error`. Snapshots and jobs must be fresh, non-aliased values. Progress must equal accepted bytes exactly and must never exceed file size.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
